beats.headline: Your first sparkling car!
beats.body: One bucket, one bay and big plans. This dusty old car wash is yours now, so let’s make it shine.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: This lot was my first business, forty years ago. Wash every car like it's your own and the town will keep coming back.

beats.headline: You’ve got a crew!
beats.body: Your first worker is scrubbing away, and the queue moves twice as fast.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Now you're an owner, not just a washer. Let your crew scrub; you keep the cash moving.

beats.headline: Mabel’s lucky sponge
beats.body: Mabel brought her old lucky sponge. For one minute your whole lot washes twice as fast. Watch the cash roll in!
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: I used this sponge on my very first day. Go on, make it count!

beats.headline: This is only the beginning
beats.body: One day you could own a farm, a theme park and even an airport. Tap your badge at the top any time to see your empire map.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Every big business starts with one bucket. Here's where yours could go.

beats.headline: Rex Goldsby wants your customers
beats.body: His shiny Sparkle Express just opened across town, and some drivers are heading his way. Wash cars in big batches and you’ll win them back.
beats.speaker: rival
beats.words: One bucket against my chain? Enjoy your quiet afternoons.

beats.headline: Sparkle Express is gone!
beats.body: Your brush tunnel washes three cars at once, and the customers came running back. Rex has packed up and left town.
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Better service beats a bigger sign, every time. He'll turn up again somewhere, mark my words.

beats.headline: A dust storm is coming!
beats.body: For the next three minutes every car is filthy, and drivers pay double for a wash. Go, go, go!
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: Storms are good for business, if you're ready for them. Keep every bay busy!

beats.headline: The storm has passed
beats.body: The dust has settled, and you kept every car moving. Nice work!

beats.headline: The Duck Fountain is here!
beats.body: The whole town loves it, and every bill now comes with a smile. Next stop: some farmland out at Willowbrook?
beats.speaker: mentor
beats.words: You've outgrown this lot. My brother Joe is selling his farmland out at Willowbrook. It won't come cheap, so save up, then go and see him.
